summary: Correct the transposed text number in the swimming citation
rationale: Supplied text 79 ends at verse 24, so 79/38 does not exist. In 97/38 the corpus has Sobah we and the translation explicitly says Der Wesir Titiliyos konnte schwimmen, matching sobaḥ-wo and er konnte schwimmen. The surrounding context is the vizier jumping into the sea to rescue Marzawan.
